spec.assertion: Zeroing the 3.05-magnitude skill1 effect must cost >1.5% of her total damage, and teammates must stay byte-identical. Fails under the nearest-wrong encodings: dropped as cosmetic, or attached to a rare trigger (burst-cast / every-200-hits) instead of every hit — both collapse the delta toward zero. Encoding-tolerant (extraHitDamagePct buff or hitCount:1 flatDamage both pass); what is pinned is the per-hit SCALE.

Structural: trigger hitCount count=200, target self, maxStacks 5, durationSec 10. Behavioural: zeroing < 1-stack < faithful (proves the buff is live AND that the 5-stack cap is worth real damage), and buffApply events are self-only with maxStacks=5 and observed stacks >= 2. Fails under trigger=shotFired/interval, maxStacks=1, or an ally-scoped target.

Value must be NEGATIVE (and ~5.04 when stat is maxAmmoPct), self, 5 stacks, 10s; sign-flipping it to +5.04% must yield strictly FEWER reload events than the faithful run. Fails under the two standard failure modes: dropped as 'defensive, no damage' (reload counts identical) or sign-inverted into a buff (reload counts reversed). Weapon-state modifiers gate shots fired, so this is a damage line.

spec.kitLine: FB enter: all allies Hit Rate +8.56%
spec.assertion: Structural: trigger fullBurstEnter (not burstCast — helm is a second B3, so the two diverge), target allies with excludeSelf falsy, durationSec 15. Behavioural: distinct targetSlug count equals the whole comp size and includes self; >=2 distinct expiresFrame values (re-fires per FB, not a passive); first-application expiresFrame is exactly 300 frames later than a durationSec=10 patch (15s vs the FB-length guess); zeroing lowers her AND at least one teammate (Hit Rate is a team core-lift, not a self stat).

The buff itself is asserted (stat atkPct not attackDamagePct, self-only targetSlug, durationSec 10, trigger hitCount count=200). The 'during increasing Hit Rate status' condition is a requires-own-buff-active gate with NO schema primitive (fbGate/requiresTargetStatus/resourceGate all key off something else), so an ungated model over-credits every activation before the first Full Burst; the ordering check (no application before the first fullBurstStart) is it.skip'd pending that primitive. ⚑ divergence risk: a driver may have approximated the gate with fbGate:'inFb', which would UNDER-credit (the status runs 15s, the FB window ~15s but offset).

Structural: fullBurstExtend seconds=5 on a burstCast trigger. Behavioural: strictly more damage events with inFullBurst=true than a run with the effect removed. Measuring the WINDOW (in-FB hit count) rather than totals is what discriminates a real extension from a flat damage bump; fails under dropped/0s.

Structural: unlimitedAmmo durationSec=15, target self, trigger burstCast. Behavioural: reload count strictly lower than a run without it AND strictly greater than zero. Fails under both nearest-wrongs: dropped (identical reload counts) and unbounded/whole-fight (zero reloads).

⚑ READING FLAGGED: 'deals X% of final ATK as damage for 15 sec' on an auto-aiming firing mode is read as a PER-HIT rider on every Destroy-Mode bullet, not a 1/sec DoT — the kit gives no tick interval and the mode is a weapon behaviour. Discriminator: zeroing it must cost >1% of her total (per-hit at ~40 hits/s for 15s of a ~40s cycle), which a 15-tick DoT (~34% ATK per burst, <0.1% of total) cannot reach. Also asserted burstCast-keyed, self-scoped, bounded (60s patch adds damage), and teammate-inert. A RED here is an ENCODING divergence to adjudicate, not a magnitude quibble.

No engine primitive and no observable on the partless scope-lock boss (hit LOCATION never changes a damage value; only core vs non-core does). Must appear in the override's `unmodeled.burst` rather than being silently dropped — asserted as an it.skip so a missing `unmodeled` record is visible without failing a legitimate override.

The comp must produce >=3 burstCast and >=3 fullBurstStart events and non-zero in-FB hits, otherwise every FB-keyed assertion above tests nothing; all three slots must carry blocks; no `ignored`/`unsupported` effects (validator rule — skips belong in `note`/`unmodeled`).

fixtures: controlComp('modernia', true) only — liter B1 / crown B2 / modernia B3 / helm B3 against the Fire boss. helm is KEPT (helm=true) because no assertion reads an absolute number: every damage claim is a delta between two runs of the identical fixture, so helm's buffs cancel, while dropping her would remove a second B3 and with it the burstCast-vs-fullBurstEnter divergence that the S2a trigger-identity assertion depends on. The comp must contain B1+B2 or a lone B3 makes ZERO Full Bursts and the S2a/burst lines would all be vacuous — asserted explicitly. 12 hoisted runs (1 baseline + 11 counterfactuals), each a full 180s deterministic sim, no seed.
gaps: skill2 'during increasing Hit Rate status' — no requires-own-buff-active gate exists in the schema (fbGate / requiresTargetStatus / resourceGate all key off something else); the ordering check (no ATK+29.38 application before the first fullBurstStart) is it.skip'd. An ungated model over-credits the pre-first-FB activations; an fbGate:'inFb' approximation under-credits the tail of the 15s status window.

burst Destroy Mode 'extends line of sight / auto-aims at all enemies in range / stage target treated as a single enemy regardless of parts' — no primitive and no observable on the partless boss (hit location never changes a damage value); it.skip'd as a check that the text is recorded in unmodeled.burst.

NOT a gap but flagged: the S1b Crit Damage 10s duration is board-inert against any longer value because the 200-hit threshold re-fires roughly every 5s at ~40 hits/s — the exact 10s is pinned structurally, and only its liveness (durationSec patched to 1s) is pinned by damage.
⚑ Hit-Rate -> core magnitude (hitRatePct -> hrCoreMult) is measurement-derived, not kit-stated; the S2a assertions test presence, scope, trigger and duration, never the size of the core lift.
